title: Questions reviewers ask
body: Prepare an answer, with evidence, for each. Answers are not shown here.

hotspots.label: Completeness
hotspots.detail: Show what happens if page 37 of 384 returns an empty list with no cursor.

hotspots.label: Membership
hotspots.detail: A user is removed from a group in the source. When and how does Glean reflect it?

hotspots.label: Permission-only change
hotspots.detail: Only a page's read groups change. Which code path pushes that?

hotspots.label: Rename
hotspots.detail: A page is renamed. How many documents exist afterward?

hotspots.label: Secrets
hotspots.detail: Where is the source token stored, and who rotates it on day 90?

hotspots.label: Intended cleanup
hotspots.detail: A nightly run deletes 25% of documents on purpose. What will users see tomorrow, and what do you do?

hotspots.label: Proof of indexing
hotspots.detail: The Job shows Completed. How do you know documents were indexed?
